description.en:
AFSOS, poetical name of Mir Sher ‘‘All, the 
son of Saiyid ‘All Muzaffar lOian, and descendant 
of the Prophet through Imam Dia‘far Sdik.
description.tr: EFSOS, Peygamber'in İmam Cafer Sâdık yoluyla soyundan gelen Seyyid Ali Muzaffer Han'ın oğlu Mir Şer Ali'nin şiirsel adı.

derived_from.edition_or_version: Encyclopaedia of Islam, 1st ed. (Brill, 1913-1936), digitized/structured ei1_lite v-repo; OCR-derived — noise possible
